incident: Theseus tests/unit/reviewer/test_legacy_transition.py and test_github.py before fddee19: tests faked posting and downloads by patching the standard library (subprocess.run and Popen through a module attribute) instead of a seam the code owns.

defects.title: Tests patch subprocess.run through the github module instead of an owned seam
defects.detail: monkeypatch.setattr(github.subprocess, 'run', ...) replaces the standard library's process runner process-wide and ties the test to how download_state shells out. Move the gh call behind a function github owns and patch that.
